# bash_legacy_allow.txt — commands that MUST be allowed by tier 5 (legacy)
# with the fixture list in legacy_patterns.txt. No LLM, no cache.
#
# Tier 5 matches per call on the shell AST: one simple call, or a plain
# pipeline in which EVERY call matches a listed pattern on its own.
# A pipe into a read-only filter therefore still passes, but only when
# that filter (head, grep, wc here) is itself on the list.

# --- one listed call ---
acme-cli status
acme-cli status --verbose
acme-cli logs --since 1h
acme-report weekly "team a"
acme-report weekly 'a; b && c'
acme-report weekly $HOME/out
acme-report weekly "${HOME}/out"

# --- harmless redirects: fd duplication and /dev/null ---
acme-cli status 2>&1
acme-cli status 2>/dev/null
acme-cli status >/dev/null 2>&1

# --- pipeline where every call is listed ---
acme-cli logs | head -20
acme-cli logs --since 1h | grep -i error | wc -l
acme-cli logs 2>&1 | grep timeout
